prompts.title: Romantic Couple Walking on Beach
prompts.prompt:
A romantic couple photoshoot on an overcast, moody beach. A young couple walks barefoot hand-in-hand along the wet shoreline toward the camera. The woman, on the left, wears a flowing white maxi dress with thin spaghetti straps, holding the skirt lightly with her free hand as it billows in the wind; her naturally wavy hair blows across her shoulder as she smiles softly, looking down. The man, on the right, wears a relaxed white linen shirt with sleeves rolled to the forearms, top buttons open, and loose white linen trousers; he gazes tenderly at her, natural hair tousled by the breeze, wearing a wristwatch.
Background: misty grey ocean with gentle white waves, fog-shrouded green mountains fading into haze, dark wet rocks along the right side of the shore. Soft diffused overcast lighting, muted grey and white color palette, wet reflective sand mirroring the couple's figures. Cinematic, editorial fashion photography style, shallow depth of field, high contrast, full-body shot, natural candid movement, serene and intimate mood. Shot on 85mm lens, 8k, high resolution.
Aspect ratio: 4:5

prompts.title: Couple Walking on Tropical Beach
prompts.prompt: Create a premium, ultra-realistic tropical vacation portrait of the uploaded couple, preserving each person’s individual facial identity, skin tone, age, hairstyle and recognizable features without blending their features. Dress the woman in an airy beige linen V-neck midi dress with natural flowing movement, simple jewellery and a woven straw shoulder bag, leaving her barefoot. Dress the man in a lightweight white linen button-down shirt with rolled sleeves, tailored beige shorts and clean white low-top sneakers. Place them walking naturally side by side toward the camera along the shoreline, following a slightly diagonal path across the sand. They share relaxed body language, a gentle arm-around interaction and warm, cheerful expressions while looking at each other. Surround them with soft sand, turquoise water and towering green limestone cliffs, with a light ocean breeze moving their hair and clothing. Position the camera several metres ahead of them at eye level, capturing a natural frontal three-quarter full-body view. Use soft golden-hour sunlight, accurate skin exposure, realistic fabric and skin texture, an 85mm perspective and f/3.2 depth of field. Premium tropical travel lifestyle photography, 4:5 aspect ratio.

prompts.title: Skyline Smile
prompts.prompt: Create a photorealistic, full body, high-end editorial portrait of a female adult with a natural skin tone, standing outdoors on a grassy hilltop. Use the uploaded image strictly ONLY for 100% true face and identity reference. She has naturally styled hair. She wears a short-puff-sleeve top with a brown and cream geometric batik-style pattern and a small decorative bow at the neckline, paired with high-waisted tailored off-white linen trousers and crisp white classic sneakers. She has a friendly, confident, and natural smile, looking directly at the lens. Her pose is playful, standing angled to the side while lifting her left leg back at the knee. She holds a clear plastic cup of iced matcha latte in her hand. The background features a breathtaking, expansive view of a massive blue crater lake nestled between majestic, lush green mountains under a bright sky with soft clouds. Soft, beautifully diffused natural daylight provides even, flattering illumination across the subject with no overexposure. Subtle high-angle shot, camera positioned slightly above eye level and gently tilted downward. Captured on a Sony A1 using an 85mm f/1.4 lens at f/1.8, ISO 100, 1/1000 shutter speed. Shallow depth of field creates a creamy bokeh effect on the sweeping landscape background, keeping the subject in razor-sharp focus. 8k resolution, ultra-detailed, photorealistic, no warm tone. Aspect ratio 4:5

prompts.title: Lost in Thought
prompts.prompt:
Create a 3:4 cinematic, atmospheric editorial portrait using the attached photo as the exact face and identity reference. A solitary man/woman stands alone in the middle of vast, wind-swept sage green grass fields. Tall grass surrounds the subject completely, flowing in strong currents like ocean waves, partially obscuring the body and creating motion, depth, and solitude. The subject wears a simple, loose white shirt that softly contrasts with the rich green landscape.
Dark hair is slightly messy, with natural strands moving in the wind. The head is gently tilted downward, eyes cast toward the ground, conveying a quiet, introspective, melancholic mood. Expression is calm, distant, and emotionally restrained. Compose the frame slightly off-center, from a subtle elevated angle. No visible horizon, the frame is fully immersed in grass texture. Use a muted natural palette of sage green, deep olive, and soft off-white. Shoot vertical 3:4, telephoto perspective, shallow depth of field, cinematic framing. Film photography aesthetic with visible grain, soft edge falloff, atmospheric light, wind-driven motion blur in the grass. Quiet, poetic storytelling; ultra-detailed yet natural, magazine-cover editorial quality. No text, no watermark.

prompts.title: Beyond the Fence Line
prompts.prompt:
Use the uploaded reference image as the absolute and locked facial identity source.
The face must remain 100% identical — no changes to facial structure, proportions, skin texture, beard shape, jawline, nose, lips, or eyes. Identity accuracy is critical.

Create a rugged, cinematic portrait of a solitary man standing waist-deep inside tall, dry, wind-swept grass in an open rural field. The grass is golden-brown and straw-like, uneven in height, naturally bent and flowing with the wind. Foreground grass partially overlaps the frame, softly blurred, creating strong depth and a natural, immersive feel.

The subject stands slightly left of center, captured in a medium shot (waist to chest level). His body faces away from the camera, while his head is turned back over his left shoulder, looking directly at the viewer with a serious, intense, and contemplative expression. His posture is relaxed yet grounded, conveying quiet strength and introspection.

He has neatly styled dark hair, a well-groomed dark beard, a strong jawline, and sharp, focused eyes.
He wears a muted olive-green rugged field jacket, made of thick outdoor fabric, slightly worn and textured, with a natural fit (not tailored). The jacket blends organically with the earthy environment and reinforces a raw, masculine, outdoor aesthetic.

Background & Environment

Behind him, positioned centrally in the background, stands an old, weathered wooden gate or board structure, framed by two tall, rough wooden posts. The wood appears aged, cracked, and darkened by time and weather. The structure feels abandoned and symbolic — like a boundary, passage, or forgotten entrance. It is slightly out of focus, ensuring the subject remains dominant while adding narrative depth.

The sky is filled with heavy, dramatic overcast clouds, layered in cool grey and slighty blue tones. The clouds are thick and dense, creating a moody, cinematic atmosphere without visible sunlight.

Lighting & Color Tone

Lighting is soft, diffused, and natural, coming from the cloud cover above.
No harsh highlights or strong shadows — only gentle contrast, subtle facial highlights, and smooth shadow falloff across the jacket and grass.

Color grading is film-inspired:

Warm earthy browns and golden tones in the grass

Muted olive and neutral tones on the subject

Cool, desaturated greys and blues in the sky

The overall palette feels natural, grounded, and cinematic, with a calm but dramatic mood.

Camera & Technical Details

Lens: 85mm

Aperture: f/1.8

Shallow depth of field with strong subject separation

Soft bokeh in foreground grass and background

Ultra-sharp facial details with realistic skin texture

Natural perspective compression

High dynamic range, balanced exposure

Style & Mood

Cinematic realism, moody and introspective tone, film-grade color grading, atmospheric depth, natural textures, modern movie-poster aesthetic, ultra-high resolution, professional photography quality.

prompts.title: Violet Skies & Ocean Eyes
prompts.prompt:
Aspect Ratio: 4:5 (vertical)
Style: Ultra-realistic, cinematic lifestyle photography
Face Matching (CRITICAL):

Use the uploaded reference face strictly for exact face matching. Preserve the subject’s 100% original facial identity, including bone structure, symmetry, proportions, jawline, eye shape, nose, lips, skin tone, beard density, hairstyle and natural facial texture.

❌ Do NOT beautify, stylize, alter, smooth, or change the face in any way.

✔ Maintain real skin pores, natural imperfections, and authentic human detail.
Main Subject (Man)
A young man with dark hair styled upward naturally. He wears thin-rimmed eyeglasses. His expression is calm, thoughtful, and contemplative.
Pose:

He is seated casually on rugged coastal rocks. His body faces slightly to the right while his head turns to the left, gazing toward the ocean horizon. His right leg is bent with the foot resting on the rock, right hand placed on the knee. His left leg extends down the rocky slope, and he leans back comfortably on his left hand.
Clothing & Accessories
Unbuttoned cream / off-white linen collared shirt
Plain white crew-neck t-shirt underneath
Light beige / khaki slim-fit trousers with a subtle distressed rip on the left knee
Beige suede loafers or espadrille slip-ons
Accessories:

Layered silver necklaces with rectangular pendants
Multiple beaded bracelets on the right wrist
Dark bracelet or band on the left wrist
Foreground (Terrain & Flora)
Rugged grey-brown coastal rocks with rough texture. Bright wildflowers grow naturally from rock crevices—vivid yellow daisies mixed with small purple and lilac flowers. Sparse green grass and stems add natural realism.
Background (Sea & Sky)
The ocean stretches to the horizon, textured with choppy waves reflecting deep blues and purples mixed with warm sunset tones of pink, peach, and orange. White foamy waves crash against the cliffs on the left.
The sky shows a dramatic sunset gradient—deep purple at the top transitioning into vibrant orange and peach near the horizon. The sun is visible just above the horizon at the center, casting warm reflections across the water. Soft clouds glow from below, and a faint distant coastline appears on the far right.
Lighting & Camera
Golden-hour sunset backlighting creates a soft rim light on the hair and shoulders. A gentle front fill light keeps the face and upper body clearly visible and naturally lit.
Shot with a 50mm lens at f/1.4, producing shallow depth of field and creamy background blur while keeping the subject’s face sharply focused.
Color & Aesthetic
Balanced cinematic color grading with strong contrast between cool ocean blues and warm sunset oranges. High saturation, sharp clarity, premium editorial lifestyle look. Photorealistic — no CGI, no illustration, no artificial blur.
